aborted_v1_preference.rule: hash-order four pairs within path with the literal aborted-v1 salt and null-byte field separators, then pair adjacent entries

block_selection.construction_rule: within each exact relation path, enumerate all three perfect matchings of its four frozen pairs; lexicographically minimize prohibited normalized cross-pair alias containment, deviation from the aborted-v1 hash-adjacent matching, and the new-v2 salted SHA-256; require selected overlap cost zero and retain fixed physical pair and chain slots while crossing which pair is focal

cross_pair_alias_overlap_rule.normalization: Unicode-NFKC casefold, replace punctuation as in the parent's canonicalizer, then remove whitespace to form one compact alphanumeric alias
cross_pair_alias_overlap_rule.prohibited_when: one compact source/bridge/answer alias is a character substring of an alias from the other natural pair in the same physical block; normalized aliases are nonempty, so there is no length threshold
cross_pair_alias_overlap_rule.reason_floor_not_used: all 31 paths admit a zero-overlap perfect matching under no-threshold compact containment, so the stronger rule is feasible
cross_pair_alias_overlap_rule.scope: cross-pair only; within-pair aliases belong to the already frozen natural candidate-pair design and are unchanged by block construction

common.claim_boundary: within-panel behavioral specificity of Ouro-2.6B candidate likelihoods to answer-connected versus candidate-disconnected graph rewiring on the already exposed held-out 2Wiki population; not a new held-out replication, hidden-state mechanism, free-generation result, or architecture-wide claim
common.direct_metric: teacher-forced identity-based candidate-prefix sequence likelihood; equal candidate token counts within focal pair; EOS excluded

estimands.C_K: path-balanced mean(z_off_path_swap-z_on_path_swap), averaging crossed roles, both natural query arms, both candidate orders, and two disjoint blocks
estimands.reference_margin: z=logP(focal queried chain's original answer)-logP(focal foil)

frozen_gates.doubled_context_substrate: lower95(BASE K3 state-correct accuracy)>0.5, lower95(O3)>0, and lower95(O31=O3-O1)>0
frozen_gates.no_null_equivalence_claim: N_K is descriptive; failure to reject N_K=0 is not evidence of equivalence
frozen_gates.overall_confirmation: C3, A31, BASE-K3 competence, O3, and O31 gates all pass conjunctively

common.inference: 10,000 path-cluster bootstrap draws over 31 exact relation paths after averaging the two disjoint physical blocks and every crossed within-block factor

intervention.base: four intact S->B->A chains; two focal and two disconnected distractors
intervention.matched_edit: each swap changes exactly two first-hop OBJECT fields and preserves every entity string, relation string, physical evidence slot, and terminal edge; crossed focal roles use each exact physical edit once on-path and once off-path
intervention.off_path_swap: transpose the two first-hop bridge objects within the candidate-disconnected distractor pair; both focal candidate paths remain intact
intervention.on_path_swap: transpose the two first-hop bridge objects within the focal candidate pair; terminal facts and the distractor pair remain fixed

common.scope: matched on-path versus candidate-disconnected bridge rewiring control
